newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firm on IPE rise, premiums easing.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firm on IPE rise, premiums easing.

text.p: European jet fuel prices gained on Monday on the back of IPE gas oil futures.
IPE Nov closed up $7.50 at 234.00 a tonne while crude rose to a new five-yer high.
One trader said that on the barge market Nov +$30/32 sounded plausible, adding trade was thin and buying interest lacklustre.
On cargoes, one trader said premiums in the Med were easing slightly and the market was well-supplied, removing the justification for bringing in cargoes from the Gulf.
